messages:
Alex: starting canary for release r202 now — 20% traffic, eu-west primary. kicking off deploy window 14:05 UTC. @DeployBot please post checks.
DeployBot: CANARY STARTED r202 (20%) at 14:05 UTC. health checks enabled: slo-monitor, error-rate, 5xx-count, latency-p95. will post updates every 60s.
Maria: watching slo dashboard -> https://dash.redwood.internal/slo/r202 (p95 baseline = 180ms)
Jamal: noticed a small 5xx blip on embed-service at 14:06, spike to 1.2% (baseline 0.2%). tagging @Maria.
Maria: seen. correlation w/ embed-service v3.4.1 route. digging logs.
Elena: what's current deploy error budget for the window?
Maria: error budget for deploy window = 0.5% across prod routes. currently at 0.9% for this canary (includes earlier background noise).
Jamal: stack traces show NPE in kv-cache init. sample log: ```ERROR kv_cache.go:112 "nil pointer deref" service=embed-service host=i-02a```. looks like a bad config with new quantization flag.
Alex: hmm, that sounds like a regression. Is it isolated to canary pods?
Maria: yes, only canary pods showing the error. regular pods stable.
Elena: given error budget breached, recommend pause and rollback. anyone object?
Jamal: +1 rollback. too risky for 20% and we have user-facing 5xxs.
Alex: ok initiating rollback and pinning back to r201. @DeployBot please start rollback and pin version.
DeployBot: ROLLBACK INITIATED by @Alex. traffic shift -> r201. pin applied: model-serving -> r201 (sticky). will confirm when 100% traffic on r201.
SRE-Bot: ALERT: canary_5xx_rate > threshold (1m avg 1.1%). incident doc auto-created: https://inc.redwood/internal/INC-2023-canary-r202
Maria: after rollback p95 and 5xx trending back down. monitoring for ripple.
Elena: please add a release note entry and block r202 until kv-cache flag removed from candidate.
Alex: noted. I'll update release notes: "r202 rolled back due to kv-cache init NPE with quant flag; investigation ongoing" and reopen PR when flag gated.
Jamal: for postmortem: capture how config landed without e2e flag gating. add canary gate to reject builds with unknown runtime flags.
Maria: follow-up tasks created in the deploy board. will also add a smoke test to hit kv-cache init path in staging.
Alex: thanks everyone. marking deploy window as paused. summary: canary started, 5xx spike on embed-service due to runtime flag regression, rollback to r201, pin applied, postmortem & follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE. traffic now at 100% r201. closing canary.
SRE-Bot: SLO STATUS: p95 latency back to baseline, 5xx rate falling under threshold. will continue 30m additional observation.
Elena: please keep the change window flagged in calendar and notify product owners about the rollback.
Alex: pinged product and CS. I'll schedule a short post-deploy sync at 15:00 UTC.
Maria: attaching quick grep of logs for triage: ```grep -R "kv_cache.go" /var/log/canary | head -n 50```
Jamal: saved core dump for offending pod and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-dumps/canary/r202/pod-02a-core.tar.gz
Elena: nice. wrap up: rollout cancelled, r202 blocked until config gating added. closing thread after 30m verification. :rotating_light:
